budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HBM-HCBANK6 10-20 (H.STA.BLK.17.2): new hard child of the HC quarter hub cluster hbm_hcq_hub_c1. The SAFE 1 hub (hbm_hcq_hub_s1/s1b/s2/s2b) had ONE clock root for 51,337 flops over the 734.4 square; its --cts gates stalled 4 h in repair_timing -hold (28,269 hold endpoints, sink arrival 566..849 ps) and its mapped netlist failed the native32 census (1,057 drivers > 32, 693 inside the 63 LAT-7 adders). This slice takes levels 1..4 of the 6-level subtree over 16 chunk sums (15 of 63 adders, ~9.8k flops), every adder the reviewed native-fanout LAT-7 graph (ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_fan32 SAFE_DIST 1, 520dbea3a, SAT-equal to LAT 7 DRST 0), with its own compact clock root; one master x4. Outline 129.6 x 108.0 (1.2:1, ~43 % util of the ~6.0k um2 estimate), W face 515 pins = 4.8/um, E face 78 outputs.
